seller_feedback.feedback_text: Excellent experience with this seller. The EPYC 7V73X arrived in perfect condition and was securely packaged for international shipping. Shipping was reasonably fast - it took only 2 weeks to reach the EU, including the customs clearance process. The CPU is fully functional, passed all stress tests, and is not vendor-locked. Excellent communication regarding the paperwork. I would definitely buy from them again.

Buyer beware: Phantom stock + misdirected shipping scam.

Seller listed item with "More than 10 available" as in stock. After purchase, seller claimed it was "not available" and asked to cancel. I refused. 

Seller then provided tracking 2020353860, but DHL confirmed in writing the package was not addressed to me and did not contain the motherboard. 

Clear false tracking / misdirected package scam. Full refund issued by eBay. Avoid this seller.
